purpose: Own the meaning, lifetime, and allowed dependencies of inference declarations.

ModelArtifact.meaning: An identified set of model parameters bound to architecture and tokenizer identity.
ModelArtifact.lifetime: Immutable for an artifact identity. Preparation seed is provenance, never a request control.

InferenceSystem.meaning: The execution strategy and supported request capabilities of the selected inference implementation.
InferenceSystem.lifetime: Fixed for an identified system configuration.

InferenceRequest.meaning: One input and generation policy submitted for execution against a selected model and system.
InferenceRequest.lifetime: Editable before submission; immutable in a run binding.

RunBinding.meaning: The exact model, system, and workload declarations consumed by one execution.
RunBinding.lifetime: Immutable evidence, including after a later workload draft is edited.
excludes: independent copies of their individual settings

RunOutcome.meaning: Observed generation decisions and the condition that ended this execution.
RunOutcome.lifetime: Immutable evidence derived from execution, not requested values.
owns: selected ID count including stop controls

InspectionState.meaning: A cursor into an identified run; navigating it never executes the model.
InspectionState.lifetime: Changes on inspection; reset when the bound run changes.

Workload.meaning: Identified requests and their arrival declarations; array order breaks equal-time ties.
Workload.lifetime: Immutable in an identified execution record.

RunEvent.meaning: An occurrence recorded by execution, ordered and linked to actual earlier causes.
RunEvent.lifetime: Immutable in an identified execution record.

NumericalEvidence.meaning: Concrete single-request numerical traces and their exact computation binding.
NumericalEvidence.lifetime: Immutable in an identified execution record.

RunRecord.meaning: The resolved workload and ordered evidence from one execution.
RunRecord.lifetime: Immutable in an identified execution record.

ServiceBoundary.meaning: HTTP capability and admission-error records; transport does not own domain meaning.
ServiceBoundary.lifetime: Immutable in an identified execution record.
